📌 Key points要点

⭐ Must know必须记住
  • Add/subtract LIKE radicals only — simplify each first: 12​+27​=53​.只有同类根式才能加减——先逐个化简：12​+27​=53​。
  • Multiply outside × outside, inside × inside; expand brackets like FOIL.相乘：系数乘系数，根号里乘根号里；括号像多项式一样展开。
  • Rationalize: ×b​b​​; binomial bottom → × conjugate, (a+b​)(a−b​)=a2−b.分母有理化：单项乘 b​b​​；二项分母乘共轭式，(a+b​)(a−b​)=a2−b。

💡 A calculator says 3​−223​+1​≈−16.66, but a test wants the exact value. One multiplication by the "conjugate" turns it into −8−53​.计算器显示 3​−223​+1​≈−16.66，但考试要精确值。乘一次「共轭式」，就能化成 −8−53​。

  1. Add/subtract only LIKE radicals (same index, same radicand) — like collecting like terms: 32​+52​=82​. Simplify every radical first; unlike-looking ones often become like.只有同类根式（根指数相同、被开方数相同）才能加减——和合并同类项一样：32​+52​=82​。先把每个根式化简，看起来不同类的常常会变成同类。
  2. Multiply: outside × outside, inside × inside: (23​)(56​)=1018​=302​. Brackets are expanded exactly like polynomials (distribute / FOIL).乘法：根号外乘根号外，根号内乘根号内：(23​)(56​)=1018​=302​。带括号的就像多项式一样展开（分配律 / FOIL）。
  3. Rationalize a monomial denominator: multiply top and bottom by the radical: 3​6​⋅3​3​​=23​.分母是单项根式时有理化：分子分母同乘这个根式：3​6​⋅3​3​​=23​。
  4. Binomial denominator: multiply by its conjugate (a+b​ ↔ a−b​). Difference of squares kills the root: (a+b​)(a−b​)=a2−b.分母是二项式时，乘以它的共轭式（a+b​ ↔ a−b​）。平方差公式消掉根号：(a+b​)(a−b​)=a2−b。

🧮 Key formulas关键公式

mna​⋅knb​=mknab​
Multiplying radicals (same index)同次根式相乘
(a​+b​)(a​−b​)=a−b
Conjugates multiply to a rational number共轭式相乘得有理数
🎯 Test tip考试提示
Every "simplify" answer must have no radical in the denominator and no radicand with a square factor. A quick decimal check of the original vs your answer catches almost every sign slip.「化简」的最终答案分母不能有根号，被开方数不能有平方因数。用小数对比原式和答案，几乎能抓住所有符号错误。

🧭 How to get started怎么入手

Ask yourself these five, in order, before writing anything. Every worked example on this page is labelled with them.动笔之前，按顺序问自己这五个问题。本页每道例题的步骤都标了它们。

  1. 🔎 Given已知
    Which operation is it: add/subtract, multiply, or a radical in the denominator? Simplify every radical first; unlike-looking ones often turn out alike.是哪种运算：加减、相乘，还是分母里有根号？先把每个根式化简；看起来不同类的常常会变成同类。
  2. 🎯 Asked求什么
    An exact answer in simplest form: like radicals collected, no square factor inside a root, and no root left in the denominator.最简精确值：同类根式已合并，根号里没有平方因数，分母里不留根号。
  3. ✏️ Picture it画出来
    For two brackets, a 2×2 box (rows = first bracket, columns = second). For a binomial denominator, write its conjugate right under it with the middle sign flipped.两个括号相乘时，画一个 2×2 方格（行是第一个括号，列是第二个）。分母是二项式时，在它正下方写出共轭式，中间的符号反过来。
  4. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Add only like radicals. Multiply outside × outside, inside × inside. One-term denominator: multiply by b​b​​. Two-term denominator: multiply top AND bottom by the conjugate.只合并同类根式。相乘：外乘外、里乘里。分母是单项：乘 b​b​​。分母是两项：分子分母「同时」乘共轭式。
  5. ✅ Check检验
    Type the original and your answer into a calculator; they must agree to at least 3 decimal places.把原式和你的答案都输进计算器，至少小数点后 3 位要一致。

🧱 Prerequisite check先修检查

4 quick Grade 9–10 questions, about 3 minutes. Miss one and a 5-minute repair card opens right there; fix it, then carry on.4 道九、十年级小题，约 3 分钟。错了就在原地打开 5 分钟补救卡，补好再继续。

1Multiplying binomials, (a+b)2二项式相乘与 (a+b)2
Expand (x+3)(x−3).展开 (x+3)(x−3)。

🩹 5-minute repair5 分钟补一补 · Multiplying binomials, (a+b)2二项式相乘与 (a+b)2 (Grade年级 9–10)
Every term times every term (FOIL): (x+3)(x−5)=x2−5x+3x−15=x2−2x−15. A square has a middle term: (x+3)2=x2+6x+9, never x2+9.每一项乘每一项：(x+3)(x−5)=x2−5x+3x−15=x2−2x−15。平方会有中间项：(x+3)2=x2+6x+9，绝不是 x2+9。
  1. (x−4)2=(x−4)(x−4)=x2−4x−4x+16=x2−8x+16.(x−4)2=(x−4)(x−4)=x2−4x−4x+16=x2−8x+16。
  2. Shortcut: (a±b)2=a2±2ab+b2 — middle term =2× first × last.捷径：(a±b)2=a2±2ab+b2——中间项＝2×首项×末项。
Try one:试一道：
Expand (2x−3)2.展开 (2x−3)2。

2Multiplying binomials, (a+b)2二项式相乘与 (a+b)2
Expand (2x−1)2.展开 (2x−1)2。

🩹 5-minute repair5 分钟补一补 · Multiplying binomials, (a+b)2二项式相乘与 (a+b)2 (Grade年级 9–10)
Every term times every term (FOIL): (x+3)(x−5)=x2−5x+3x−15=x2−2x−15. A square has a middle term: (x+3)2=x2+6x+9, never x2+9.每一项乘每一项：(x+3)(x−5)=x2−5x+3x−15=x2−2x−15。平方会有中间项：(x+3)2=x2+6x+9，绝不是 x2+9。
  1. (x−4)2=(x−4)(x−4)=x2−4x−4x+16=x2−8x+16.(x−4)2=(x−4)(x−4)=x2−4x−4x+16=x2−8x+16。
  2. Shortcut: (a±b)2=a2±2ab+b2 — middle term =2× first × last.捷径：(a±b)2=a2±2ab+b2——中间项＝2×首项×末项。
Try one:试一道：
Expand (2x−3)2.展开 (2x−3)2。

3Perfect squares and square roots完全平方数与平方根
Simplify 48​.化简 48​。

🩹 5-minute repair5 分钟补一补 · Perfect squares and square roots完全平方数与平方根 (Grade年级 8–10)
Know the squares 1,4,9,…,225. ab​=a​b​, so 50​=25​2​=52​. But a+b​=a​+b​: 9+16​=5, not 7. x​ means the non-negative root.记住 1,4,9,…,225 这些平方数。ab​=a​b​，所以 50​=25​2​=52​。但 a+b​=a​+b​：9+16​=5，不是 7。x​ 表示非负的那个根。
  1. 72​: biggest square factor is 36 → 62​.72​：最大的平方因数是 36 → 62​。
  2. x2=49 has TWO answers x=±7, but 49​=7 only.x2=49 有两个解 x=±7，但 49​ 只等于 7。
Try one:试一道：
Which is equal to 48​?哪个等于 48​？

4Fractions: add, subtract, multiply, divide分数的四则运算
Simplify 36x+9​.化简 36x+9​。

🩹 5-minute repair5 分钟补一补 · Fractions: add, subtract, multiply, divide分数的四则运算 (Grade年级 7–9)
Add or subtract only with a common denominator: 21​+31​=63​+62​=65​. Multiply straight across. Divide = multiply by the reciprocal (flip the second fraction).加减必须先通分：21​+31​=63​+62​=65​。乘法分子乘分子、分母乘分母。除以一个分数＝乘它的倒数（把第二个分数倒过来）。
  1. 32​−41​: common denominator 12 → 128​−123​=125​.32​−41​：公分母 12 → 128​−123​=125​。
  2. 43​÷89​=43​⋅98​=3624​=32​.43​÷89​=43​⋅98​=3624​=32​。
  3. Never add denominators: 21​+31​=52​.分母不能相加：21​+31​=52​。
Try one:试一道：
Simplify 65​−41​.化简 65​−41​。

🪜 Worked → fill in → your turn例题 → 填空 → 自己做

Three versions of one idea: read a full solution, then finish a half-done one, then do one yourself with hints you open one at a time.同一个思路的三个版本：先看完整解答，再补全半成品，最后自己做——提示一次只开一个。

① Worked example — read it完整例题——看懂
Rationalize the denominator: 5​−14​.分母有理化：5​−14​。
  1. 🔎 Given已知
    The denominator has two terms, 5​ and −1, so 5​5​​ will not clear it.分母有两项：5​ 和 −1，所以乘 5​5​​ 消不掉根号。
  2. 🎯 Asked求什么
    The same value written with no root in the denominator.同一个值，写成分母没有根号的形式。
  3. ✏️ Picture it画出来
    Under 5​−1 write its conjugate 5​+1 (middle sign flipped).在 5​−1 下面写出它的共轭式 5​+1（中间符号反过来）。
  4. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Multiply top and bottom by 5​+1. Bottom: (5​−1)(5​+1)=5−1=4.分子分母同乘 5​+1。分母：(5​−1)(5​+1)=5−1=4。
  5. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Top: 4(5​+1). Divide by 4: 44(5​+1)​=5​+1.分子：4(5​+1)。除以 4：44(5​+1)​=5​+1。
  6. ✅ Check检验
    Original: 4÷1.2361≈3.2361. Answer: 2.2361+1=3.2361 ✓.原式：4÷1.2361≈3.2361。答案：2.2361+1=3.2361 ✓。
✔
5​+1
② Same idea — you fill the gaps同一思路——你来补空
Rationalize the denominator: 11​−2​9​.分母有理化：11​−2​9​。
  1. 🔎 Given已知
    Two-term denominator with two roots: the conjugate is needed.分母是两项，而且有两个根号：要用共轭式。
  2. ✏️ Picture it画出来
    ✍️
    Your turn: write the conjugate of 11​−2​.轮到你：写出 11​−2​ 的共轭式。
    11​+2​.11​+2​。
  3. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    ✍️
    Your turn: multiply the two bottoms. What is left?轮到你：把分母和共轭式相乘，剩下什么？
    (11​)2−(2​)2=11−2=9.(11​)2−(2​)2=11−2=9。
  4. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    99(11​+2​)​=11​+2​.99(11​+2​)​=11​+2​。
  5. ✅ Check检验
    Original: 9÷(3.3166−1.4142)≈4.7308. Answer: 3.3166+1.4142=4.7308 ✓.原式：9÷(3.3166−1.4142)≈4.7308。答案：3.3166+1.4142=4.7308 ✓。
Answer答案
11​+2​
③ Your turn — on paper first轮到你——先在纸上做
Rationalize and simplify: 2−3​3​+1​.分母有理化并化简：2−3​3​+1​。
  1. ✏️ Picture it画出来
    The conjugate of 2−3​ is 2+3​. Multiply top AND bottom by it.2−3​ 的共轭式是 2+3​。分子「和」分母都乘它。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Bottom: 4−3=1. Top: use a 2×2 box for (3​+1)(2+3​); 3​⋅3​=3.分母：4−3=1。分子：用 2×2 方格算 (3​+1)(2+3​)；3​⋅3​=3。
  3. ✅ Check检验
    Collect the numbers and the 3​ terms separately, then compare with the original on a calculator (about 10.196).数字和 3​ 项分开合并，再用计算器和原式比较（约 10.196）。
5+33​
  1. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Bottom: (2−3​)(2+3​)=4−3=1.分母：(2−3​)(2+3​)=4−3=1。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Top: (3​+1)(2+3​)=23​+3+2+3​=5+33​.分子：(3​+1)(2+3​)=23​+3+2+3​=5+33​。
  3. ✅ Check检验
    15+33​​=5+33​≈10.196, and the original 2.732÷0.268≈10.196 ✓.15+33​​=5+33​≈10.196，原式 2.732÷0.268≈10.196 ✓。

✏️ More worked examples, harder ones too更多例题（含更难的）
Example 1例 1L1 Know知道
Simplify 312​+227​−75​.化简 312​+227​−75​。
  1. 🔎 Given已知
    312​=3⋅23​=63​; 227​=2⋅33​=63​; 75​=53​.312​=3⋅23​=63​；227​=2⋅33​=63​；75​=53​。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    All are like radicals: 63​+63​−53​=73​.全是同类根式：63​+63​−53​=73​。
Answer答案
73​

Operations with radicals根式的四则运算Simplifying & ordering radicals根式化简与比较大小

⚙️ Fluent procedures运算熟练🧭 Choosing a strategy选择策略
💡 Key idea解题思路
Only like radicals (same index and radicand) combine; simplify first to reveal them.只有同类根式（根指数和被开方数相同）才能合并；先化简才能看出来。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Simplify every term, then add the coefficients of 3​.每项先化简，再把 3​ 的系数相加。
Example 2例 2L2 Apply会做2 methods种解法
Simplify 6​12​ and expand (23​−5​)(3​+45​).化简 6​12​，并展开 (23​−5​)(3​+45​)。
  1. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    6​12​⋅6​6​​=6126​​=26​.6​12​⋅6​6​​=6126​​=26​。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    FOIL: 23​⋅3​=6; 23​⋅45​=815​; −5​⋅3​=−15​; −5​⋅45​=−20.FOIL：23​⋅3​=6；23​⋅45​=815​；−5​⋅3​=−15​；−5​⋅45​=−20。
  3. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Collect: 6−20+815​−15​=−14+715​.合并：6−20+815​−15​=−14+715​。
  1. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Write 12=2⋅6=26​⋅6​. Then 6​26​⋅6​​=26​ — no multiplying needed.把 12 写成 2⋅6=26​⋅6​，于是 6​26​⋅6​​=26​——不用再乘。
  2. ✏️ Picture it画出来
    For the product, a 2×2 box (rows 23​, −5​; columns 3​, 45​) gives the same four terms: 6, 815​, −15​, −20, total −14+715​.乘积也可以用 2×2 方格（行 23​、−5​；列 3​、45​），得到同样四项：6, 815​, −15​, −20，合计 −14+715​。
Answer答案
26​; −14+715​

🎯 Goal考查目标
Rationalize a monomial denominator and expand a product of binomial radicals.有理化单项分母，并展开含根式的二项式乘积。
📚 Knowledge used用到的知识
Operations with radicals根式的四则运算Simplifying & ordering radicals根式化简与比较大小
💪 Abilities锻炼的能力
⚙️ Fluent procedures运算熟练🧭 Choosing a strategy选择策略
💡 Key idea解题思路
Multiply top and bottom by the radical in the denominator; FOIL treats radicals like variables, then simplify products.分子分母同乘分母中的根式；展开时把根式当字母，再化简乘积。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Rationalize first, then simplify.先有理化，再化简。
  • Split the numerator: write 12=26​⋅6​ and cancel one 6​.换条路：先观察 12=2⋅6=26​⋅6​，直接约去一个 6​。
Example 3例 3L3 Connect会用
Rationalize the denominator and simplify: 3​−223​+1​.分母有理化并化简：3​−223​+1​。
  1. ✏️ Picture it画出来
    The conjugate of 3​−2 is 3​+2. Multiply top AND bottom by it (that is multiplying by 1).3​−2 的共轭式是 3​+2。分子分母同乘它（等于乘以 1）。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Bottom: (3​−2)(3​+2)=3−4=−1. The middle terms cancel — that is the whole point.分母：(3​−2)(3​+2)=3−4=−1。中间项互相抵消——这正是乘共轭式的目的。
  3. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Top: (23​+1)(3​+2)=2⋅3+43​+3​+2=8+53​.分子：(23​+1)(3​+2)=2⋅3+43​+3​+2=8+53​。
  4. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Divide by −1: −18+53​​=−8−53​.除以 −1：−18+53​​=−8−53​。
  5. ✅ Check检验
    Check: −8−5(1.732)≈−16.66, and the original −0.2684.464​≈−16.66 ✓.验算：−8−5(1.732)≈−16.66，原式 −0.2684.464​≈−16.66 ✓。
Answer答案
−8−53​

Rationalize a binomial denominator using the conjugate.用共轭式有理化二项分母。
📚 Knowledge used用到的知识
Operations with radicals根式的四则运算Difference of squares & perfect squares平方差与完全平方

💡 Key idea解题思路
Multiplying by the conjugate makes the denominator a difference of squares, which has no radical.乘以共轭式后分母变成平方差，根号消失。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Multiply top and bottom by the conjugate 3​+2.分子分母同乘共轭式 3​+2。
  • Check numerically with 3​≈1.732 in the original and the answer.用 3​≈1.732 代入原式和答案做数值检验。

🔍 Common mistakes常见错误

Someone made each of these. Tap the line where it first goes wrong.每道题都有人这样做过。点出第一处出错的那一行。

1Adding radicals by adding the insides根式相加时把根号里的数相加
Simplify 8​+18​.化简 8​+18​。

🧠 Adding the insides feels like the same move as multiplying them. Only like radicals add, and only their outside numbers: like 2a+3a=5a.感觉相加和相乘一样，把里面的数直接合起来就行。其实只有同类根式能加，而且加的是外面的系数：就像 2a+3a=5a。

🔧 Simplify first: 22​+32​=52​. Decimal check: 2.83+4.24=7.07=52​, not 26​≈5.10.先化简：22​+32​=52​。小数检验：2.83+4.24=7.07=52​，而 26​≈5.10。

✔ 52​

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Practice练习 1

2Squaring a binomial without the middle term二项式平方漏了中间项
Expand (5​−2)2.展开 (5​−2)2。

🧠 Squaring each piece feels like the power rule (ab)2=a2b2, but that works for products, not sums. (A−B)2 means (A−B)(A−B): four products.把每一部分分别平方，像是用了 (ab)2=a2b2；可那只对乘积成立，对和差不成立。(A−B)2 就是 (A−B)(A−B)，要乘出四项。

🔧 5−2⋅25​+4=9−45​.5−2⋅25​+4=9−45​。

✔ 9−45​

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Practice练习 2

3Multiplying only the bottom by the conjugate只给分母乘共轭式
Rationalize 6​+22​.把 6​+22​ 的分母有理化。

🧠 The focus is on getting rid of the root below, so the top is forgotten. Multiplying only the bottom changes the value; top and bottom together is multiplying by 1.一心想消掉分母的根号，就忘了分子。只乘分母会改变值；分子分母一起乘才等于乘 1。

🔧 22(6​−2)​=6​−2≈0.449. Check: 2÷4.449≈0.449, not 1.22(6​−2)​=6​−2≈0.449。检验：2÷4.449≈0.449，不是 1。

✔ 6​−2

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Check-up测评 Q2 B

4Forgetting to square the number in front of the root忘了把根号前的系数平方
Rationalize 32​−214​.把 32​−214​ 的分母有理化。

🧠 (32​)2 was read as "3 times 2". The 3 is squared too: (32​)2=9⋅2=18.把 (32​)2 看成「3 乘 2」。系数 3 也要平方：(32​)2=9⋅2=18。

🔧 Bottom: 18−4=14, so 1414(32​+2)​=32​+2.分母：18−4=14，所以 1414(32​+2)​=32​+2。

✔ 32​+2

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Check-up测评 Q2 A

5Dividing only one term of the top约分时只除了分子的一项
Simplify 412+45​​.化简 412+45​​。

🧠 The 4 below divides the WHOLE top. Cancelling with the first number only quietly turns the question into 412​+45​.下面的 4 要除「整个」分子。只和第一个数约分，等于偷偷把题目改成了 412​+45​。

🔧 Divide both terms: 412​+445​​=3+5​.两项都除：412​+445​​=3+5​。

✔ 3+5​

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Practice练习 5

⚠️ Quick list速查

  • Adding unlike radicals: 2​+3​=5​. If the radicands differ after simplifying, leave them.把不同类根式相加：2​+3​=5​。化简后被开方数不同，就保持原样。
  • Multiplying only the bottom by the conjugate. Top and bottom must both be multiplied, or the value changes.只给分母乘共轭式。分子分母必须同乘，否则式子的值变了。
  • Squaring a binomial wrong: (3−2​)2=9−62​+2, not 9+2. Do not forget the middle term.二项式平方出错：(3−2​)2=9−62​+2，不是 9+2。别漏中间项。
  • Cancelling across a sum: 26+43​​=3+23​ (divide both terms), not 3+43​.只约掉一部分：26+43​​=3+23​（两项都要除），不是 3+43​。

Example 3例 3: Rationalize the denominator and simplify: 3​−223​+1​.分母有理化并化简：3​−223​+1​。

🪜 Step by step一步一步

Adding and Subtracting Radical Expressions With Square Roots and Cube Roots
The Organic Chemistry Tutor · 10 min · ↗
It covers add, subtract, multiply and conjugates in one sitting using the same kind of numbers as our examples. The (2+3​)2 case, where the middle terms do NOT cancel, is the one that shows why conjugates are special.一口气讲完加、减、乘和共轭式，数字类型和我们的例题差不多。(2+3​)2 这道中间项「不会」抵消，正好对比出共轭式为什么特别。
⏩ From 0:00 (about 11 minutes; he says "rational" in the intro but means radical): adding like radicals (45​+65​=105​) and why 43​+65​ cannot be added (0:26). 1:25 simplify first so they become like: 38​−518​=−92​. 5:03 multiplying 3​(7+3​). 6:04 conjugates, (3+5​)(3−5​)=4. 7:22 squaring (2+3​)2=7+43​.从 0:00 开始（约 11 分钟；他开头说成了 rational，其实讲的是根式）：同类根式相加（45​+65​=105​），以及 43​+65​ 为什么不能加（0:26）。1:25 先化简让它们变成同类：38​−518​=−92​。5:03 乘法 3​(7+3​)。6:04 共轭式，(3+5​)(3−5​)=4。7:22 平方 (2+3​)2=7+43​。
Radicals: Rationalizing the Denominator with Conjugates, GUIDED Examples-Pre-Calculus 11, Algebra II
Mathsupport · 5 min · ↗
One problem, done slowly, and it shows the exact moment the radical disappears from the bottom. Our hook example 3​−223​+1​ uses the same steps.只做一道题，但做得很慢，能看清分母里的根号是在哪一步消失的。我们开头的例子 3​−223​+1​ 步骤完全一样。
⏩ From 0:40 (about 4.5 minutes): rationalize 2​−13​​. A single root is not enough, so multiply top and bottom by the conjugate 2​+1 (1:00); 2:25 expands everything and the radicals in the denominator cancel to leave 2−1=1; final answer 6​+3​.从 0:40 开始（约 4.5 分钟）：把 2​−13​​ 分母有理化。只乘一个根号不够，要上下同乘共轭式 2​+1（1:00）；2:25 全部展开，分母里的根号抵消，只剩 2−1=1；最后答案 6​+3​。

📝 Test-style problems考题实战

Rationalize the Denominator and Simplify With Radicals, Variables, Square Roots, Cube Roots, Algebra
The Organic Chemistry Tutor · 10 min · ↗
It covers the single-root denominator, like our example 6​12​, including the habit of reducing the fraction at the end, which a test often marks as unfinished. He also says some teachers want ∣x∣ for x2​, so check what yours expects.讲的是分母只有一个根号的情形，和我们例题里的 6​12​ 一样，还包括最后要约分的习惯，考试里不约分常被判没做完。他也提到有的老师要求写 ∣x∣，记得问问自己老师的要求。
⏩ From 0:01 (about 11 minutes; the first 4 minutes are the key part): rationalize one square root in the bottom: 5​3​=535​​, then examples with a number that can be reduced, such as 8​2​ (1:22), and with variables, such as 4x​8​ (2:40). 3:46 simplify the denominator first, then rationalize. From 4:57 he uses cube roots and higher roots; skip those unless your teacher teaches them.从 0:01 开始（约 11 分钟，前 4 分钟最关键）：分母只有一个平方根时的有理化：5​3​=535​​，再看数字能约分的例子，如 8​2​（1:22），以及带字母的，如 4x​8​（2:40）。3:46 先化简分母，再有理化。4:57 起讲立方根和更高次根，老师没教就先跳过。

Rationalize with the conjugate. For the length use Pythagoras; the cross terms cancel.用共轭式有理化。斜面长度用勾股定理，交叉项会抵消。
(a) 27−35​​; (b) 27​ m; (c) No: slope ≈0.146>121​≈0.083.(a) 27−35​​；(b) 27​ m；(c) 不满足：坡度 ≈0.146>121​≈0.083。
  1. Slope =3+5​3−5​​⋅3−5​3−5​​=414−65​​=27−35​​.坡度 =3+5​3−5​​⋅3−5​3−5​​=414−65​​=27−35​​。
  2. Length2=(3+5​)2+(3−5​)2=(14+65​)+(14−65​)=28, so length =28​=27​ m.长度2=(3+5​)2+(3−5​)2=(14+65​)+(14−65​)=28，所以长度 =28​=27​ m。
  3. Compare: 27−35​​≈27−6.708​=0.146, and 121​≈0.083. The ramp is too steep.比较：27−35​​≈27−6.708​=0.146，而 121​≈0.083。坡道太陡。
🎯 Goal考查目标
Use radical operations to model a ramp: slope, length and a compliance decision.用根式运算为坡道建模：求坡度、长度并判断是否达标。

Operations with radicals根式的四则运算Simplifying & ordering radicals根式化简与比较大小Difference of squares & perfect squares平方差与完全平方

💡 Key idea解题思路
Conjugates cancel the radicals in both the slope and the squared lengths.共轭式让坡度和长度平方中的根号都消去。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Exact: conjugate for slope, Pythagoras for length.精确法：坡度用共轭式，长度用勾股定理。
  • Decimals: 5​≈2.236 gives run 5.236, rise 0.764, slope 0.146; length 5.2362+0.7642​≈5.29=27​.小数法：5​≈2.236，水平 5.236、高度差 0.764，坡度 0.146；长度 5.2362+0.7642​≈5.29=27​。
